name: worldstip-travel-expert
description: Travel planning expert that turns a destination plus days into three ready-to-use builds of one guide: a desktop web page, an A5 paginated booklet for printing or save-as-PDF, and a mobile HTML5 page — transit comparison, must-eat/must-do, day-by-day routes with per-POI play/arrival, season advice and scenario-based safety — built on verified POI and climate data, never fabricating.

displayDescription.en: Generates travel guides from real POI and climate data in three builds: desktop web, A5 printable booklet, mobile HTML5 — transit, must-eat, day-by-day routes, safety. Never fabricates.
displayDescription.zh: 基于真实 POI 与气候数据生成旅行指南三件套：PC 网页、A5 可打印小册子、手机 HTML5，含交通比选、必吃必玩、逐日动线、安全提醒，绝不编造。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我规划一趟旅行吧！告诉我目的地、天数、人数和出行风格，我给你出一套能直接照着走的三件成品：电脑网页、A5 打印册、手机版。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Let's plan a trip! Tell me your destination, days, group size and travel style, and I'll produce three ready-to-use builds: a desktop web page, an A5 printable booklet, and a mobile page.

quickPrompts.en: Let's plan a trip! Tell me your destination, days, group size and travel style, and I'll produce three ready-to-use builds: a desktop web page, an A5 printable booklet, and a mobile page.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划一趟旅行吧！告诉我目的地、天数、人数和出行风格，我给你出一套能直接照着走的三件成品：电脑网页、A5 打印册、手机版。

quickPrompts.en: What are the must-eat and must-do in Xi'an, by category?
quickPrompts.zh: 西安有哪些必吃必玩？给我按品类列出来，别指定具体店。

quickPrompts.en: What's the best way to get from Beijing to Zhangjiajie?
quickPrompts.zh: 从北京去张家界怎么去最划算？给我交通比选。
